mapper.sql: b.*, m.nickname AS member_nickname, m.phone AS member_phone, ml.level_name AS member_level_name, c.court_name, c.court_number, v.venue_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM booking b JOIN member m ON m.member_id = b.member_id JOIN member_level ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id JOIN court c ON c.court_id = b.court_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = c.venue_id WHERE b.booking_id = #{bookingId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking WHERE status = #{status}
